expected.command: HOME=<empty dir> CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=fixtures/claude-code npx -y ccusage@20.0.48 claude daily --json --offline -z UTC
expected.combinedCommand: HOME=<empty dir> CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=fixtures/claude-code CODEX_HOME=fixtures/codex npx -y ccusage@20.0.48 daily --json --offline -z UTC
expected.notes: ccusage 20 folds every agent into `ccusage daily` (saved as the combined file); `ccusage claude daily` gives the Claude-only view. HOME points at an empty directory so no other local agent data or ccusage config is picked up. Lines that share a message id and request id are counted once.

notes: Line types kept from real logs: queue-operation, file-history-snapshot, user (prompt and tool_result), assistant (one content block per line), attachment (hook_success), system (stop_hook_summary), last-prompt, custom-title.
Real logs also carry many attachment subtypes and api-request lines; those are omitted because importers skip them.
Lines that switch to claude-fable-5-1 set requestedModel and advisorModel to the line's model; real 2.1.309 logs only showed claude-opus-5-5 in those fields.
